rubrics.justification: The response over-interprets a low-detail single image, asserting a well-formed blastocoel, cohesive TE, and visible thinning zona that are not clearly appreciable here. It also speculates about debris/apoptotic bodies and re-grades toward 3AB/3BA without strong visual basis.

It integrates age, prior live birth/miscarriage/ectopic, BMI, PCOS, ovarian response, semen, and endometrium into prognosis reasonably well, though some links (lean PCOS phenotype, maturity-rate implications) are somewhat speculative.

The structure is logical overall, but several probability modifiers are presented with unwarranted precision and some conclusions are overstated from limited evidence, especially morphology-driven adjustments and BMI/alcohol effects.

Many recommendations are standard (proceed with transfer, luteal support, early ectopic surveillance), but others are less guideline-grounded or overreaching for this case, such as strong routine PGT-A endorsement, ERA/microbiome testing, thrombophilia/MTHFR suggestions, and IM progesterone based on lean body habitus.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer monitoring and future planning, including early beta-hCG and ultrasound because of ectopic history, protocol review, and tubal evaluation. Some suggestions are more expansive than necessary but still usable.
